meta.name: mcporter
meta.description: Use the mcporter CLI to list, configure, auth, and call MCP servers/tools directly (HTTP or stdio), including ad-hoc servers, config edits, and CLI/type generation.

copy.tagline: 通过命令行直接调用和管理 MCP 服务器与工具
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从终端操作 MCP 服务器和工具。
copy.tagline_en: Manage and call MCP servers and tools directly from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate MCP servers and tools from the terminal.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 mcporter 命令行工具直接调用 MCP 服务器上的工具，例如列出可用工具、调用工具并传入参数，以及管理认证和配置。
howto.when: 当你需要与 MCP 服务器交互，比如列出工具、调用工具、管理认证或生成代码时，可以要求 Claude 使用 mcporter 命令。

say.text: 帮我列出所有可用的 MCP 服务器和工具。
为 my-server 生成 TypeScript 类型定义。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the mcporter CLI to directly interact with MCP servers: list tools, call tools with arguments, manage authentication and configuration, and generate code.
howto.when_en: When you need to interact with MCP servers, such as listing tools, calling tools, managing auth, or generating code, you can ask Claude to use mcporter commands.

say_en.text: List all available MCP servers and tools.
Call the list_issues tool on linear server with team=ENG and limit=5.
say_en.note: Runs mcporter call linear.list_issues team=ENG limit:5
